title: Finite quotient projections of the normalized integral section comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite coefficient extension E/Q_l [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], a scheme X, the integral and quotient rings [sk-def-pe-derived-completion], an integral encoding A [def-pe-integral-presentation-encoding], and a normalized abelian comparison e [def-sfb-integral-comparison-normalization] with the endpoint identifications [def-sfb-integral-comparison-coefficients]. Suppose forgetting A.ringIso gives e under these identifications. For every positive level n+1 and normalized finite encoding f [def-pe-finite-discrete-presentation-encoding], the reconstructed section quotient map equals A.ringIso.hom followed by the completed nth projection and f.ringIso.hom. The reconstructed map is sectionScalarMap of [lem-sfb-internal-section-scalar-adjunction]; the completed projection is that of [lem-pe-integral-completion-presentation].

proof.text: Identify the source endpoint transport with the inverse image of the identity-on-functions integerPointIso. For equal topologies, continuousRingTopologyIso is eqToHom of the continuous-ring-sheaf equality, proved by equality elimination. Apply the underlying-abelian functor and the point inverse image; proof irrelevance identifies the resulting equality transport with the supplied hsrc. The target endpoint htgt has definitionally equal endpoints and hence identity transport.

Extract a, c, j and the quotient normalization equations from he. Apply the already proved integral_projection_back from the normalized restriction-square construction to e and each positive level n. Its finiteBack_ringIso lemma identifies finiteBack with the forgotten inverse of the supplied normalized finite encoding f. These lemmas require only finite quotient discreteness and finiteness, not an existence choice for f.

Cancel f.ringIso.inv and apply faithfulness of forgetting commutative ring sheaves to abelian sheaves. Rewrite the forgotten A.ringIso.hom by hc and the endpoint transports by the first step. Precompose integral_projection_back with the inverse image of integerPointIso.hom and cancel its inverse. The forgotten sectionScalarMap is exactly the pulled-back quotient on abelian sheaves, giving the required equality.

theorem integral_section_projection_normalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Encoding l E X)
    (e : (coefficientRing X (sfbCondensedIntegers l E)).X ≅ sfbCompletedIntegersAb l E X)
    (he : SfbIntegralComparison l E X e)
    (hsrc : (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).obj
          (InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionRingSheaf.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
            (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (AdicCompletion.ring l E X)) =
        (coefficientRing X (sfbCondensedIntegers l E)).X)
    (htgt : (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).obj
          (WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) =
        sfbCompletedIntegersAb l E X)
    (hc : (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).map A.ringIso.hom =
          eqToHom hsrc ≫ e.hom ≫ eqToHom htgt.symm) :
    letI := (Padic.coefficientExtensionAbsoluteValue l E).toNormedField
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : FiniteEncoding l E X n),
    InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionScalarMap (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (AdicCompletion.quotient l E X n) =
      A.ringIso.hom ≫ WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l E X n ≫
        f.ringIso.hom
